In the foreground, roughly 0.5 to 1.2 metres from the camera wearer and about 0.3 to 0.5 metres in front of the lying person, a black-and-white dog is on the carpet alongside a small light-colored object near the right edge of the frame. In frames 1 to 3, the dog is within the camera wearer's arm's reach, and the camera wearer's extended hands touch and pet the dog's head and neck at the bottom center while the dog faces left toward the lying person's head.
